title: Base Entity
description: Fields shared by every canonical domain object (Governance Decision, Incident, Design Pattern, Framework Control, Evidence Type, Board Question). Entity schemas extend this via allOf and additionally constrain 'id' to their own type-prefixed pattern.

id.description: Deterministic, human-readable, type-prefixed identifier, e.g. 'DEC-001'. Assigned sequentially per type — see /ONTOLOGY.md for the full prefix table and reserved future prefixes.

slug.description: Permanent, human-readable URL slug, unique within this object's entity type (e.g. 'decisions/<slug>'). Kebab-case. Once published, a slug should not be changed — it's the stable public address for this object, independent of the internal id.

description.description: A self-contained summary of the object. Should make sense without reading any related object.

version.description: Semantic version of this record's content. Bump on any substantive edit and add a matching entry to 'history'.

status.description: Lifecycle state of this record within the dataset (distinct from 'confidence', which grades trust in the content).

created_date.description: Date this record was first added to the dataset.

updated_date.description: Date this record was last substantively edited.

tags.description: Free-text topical tags used for cross-cutting discovery (e.g. 'bias', 'facial-recognition', 'eu-ai-act').

contributors.description: Optional names/handles of everyone who touched this record in any capacity, in support of community contribution. See created_by/reviewed_by/approved_by for specific roles.

created_by.description: Who authored this record's first version.

reviewed_by.description: Who most recently reviewed this record's content against its citations.

approved_by.description: Who approved this record's current confidence/status. For records promoted via /ingestion, this is the human_review.reviewer.

citations.description: Sources backing this record's claims. See /docs/citation-model.md for when this must be non-empty.

relationships.description: Typed, directed edges from this object to other canonical objects. See /docs/relationship-model.md. Soft limit 5, hard limit 7 outbound edges per object — see /validators.
